MC.error: per-configuration binomial Monte Carlo standard error; pooled standard error from per-sample mean across20 using common random numbers
MC.estimand: conditional success probability for each saved eight-ticket configuration; preserve all overlap; arithmetic mean across20 configurations
MC.generator: NumPy default_rng;100000 calls choice(49,6,replace=False); sort each row, add1; same fair main-six samples for all20 fixed allocations and FixedBlocks
MC.inference: configuration geometry only; no adaptive history refit, no null p-value or Holm claim; does not test predictive advantage

specification.coverage: mark all positive triples contained in the completed ticket; no weight counted twice across tickets
specification.diagnostic: sum all positive triple weights containing each number; descending score midrank; never used to select tickets
specification.effective_triples: count of distinct historical triples with c_S>=2, before the target
specification.fallback: when no positive residual triple remains, append unused exact FixedBlocks-E20 tickets in original order until eight; no duplicate whole tickets
specification.fallback_contribution: report fallback tickets, fallback-success draws, greedy-success draws, fallback-only draws and both; overlapping successes not double counted
specification.grow: add one distinct number1..49 maximizing newly covered residual triple weight until six; ties smallest number
specification.history: all main-six draws from26/047 strictly before each target; no decay/window search
specification.overlap: numbers may occur in multiple tickets; no global number exclusion
specification.screen: successes>=9/20 passes exploratory screen only; otherwise disable; no retuning or forward authorization
specification.seed_triple: highest positive weight not covered by any earlier ticket; ties lexicographic
specification.success: at least one of eight tickets has>=3 main numbers; at most once per target; special ignored
specification.triples: 20 unordered sorted triples per draw; cumulative c_S; w_S=max(c_S-1,0)
specification.window: 26/096-115 exactly20 targets; train starts26/047; no other historical window scored
